summary: John's 6th-great-grandfather per the tree (father of Mary Young Croup) - unproven.
bio: The tree shows John Young Sr (1751-1813), with a document image, as father of Mary Young. 'Young' is too common in Northampton County to resolve online, and both he and his wife carry identical 1751-1813 dates. Lead (speculative): a 'Johannes Young/Jung' heads both lists of the 1754 Phoenix, the same ship as Andreas Grub; if he came from the Kusel area he could be the father of a John b. 1751 (then a 3-year-old, not listed by name). The Jettenbach Grubs had married Jungs for generations. Plumb's 1885 History of Hanover's John Young is a 1770s Paxtang/Lancaster 'Stewart associate', a different man. No SAR record for a John Young of Northampton was found.
sources: Johnny Meier's Ancestry tree (screenshots IMG_7791-7840 in John's Google Drive), transcribed in research/tree_transcription.md and Ancestry tree screenshots (section 2.2.2)
